name: Sri Sumbhajee's Crispy Vegetable Samosa with Tamarind & Yogurt Raita (Pirate Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: Spiced potato filling is soft, but the deep-fried pastry shell, whole green peas, and garam masala/chili spices irritate flares.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If tasting in remission, eat the soft potato center only and skip the fried pastry corners and whole peas.
watchOuts: Whole green peas and Indian chili spices
